title: Three days in Ella — Jen Seymour
creator: jenseymour0
scope: Three days based in Ella; airport transfers not described

items.details: Three-waterfall tour arranged informally with a tuk-tuk driver. Ravana Falls is named; the other two waterfalls are not. Swimming/rope-swing footage appears, but the precise locations are unresolved.
Nine Arch Bridge, sunset drinks at Café Soul overlooking the bridge, then food in Ella at an unnamed restaurant.
Little Adam's Peak hike followed by Ravana Pool Club. Creator bought entry without reserving a bed and reports paying about £12 at the time. This is not a current quote.
Café hopping and food. Train-track walking is described/shown but is not carried into the proposed itinerary.
